**Provisional status:** both batches come from the Harborview CDMO fed-batch delivery, which is still in review — all 46 values used (23 per batch) are unreviewed and were read from the delivery files without reviewer acceptance, so verify the delivery before relying on these numbers. The comparison is descriptive only: batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded for these runs, so a difference between them cannot be attributed to the runs' conditions. The Northfield October and November deliveries are also still in review but are not part of this comparison.
